metadata.trajectory_summary: Original agent copied all 4 jpgs from all subfolders. This variation restricts scope to vacation/ only, requiring selective path filtering.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open terminal, use find with path constraints, copy specific subsets of files
metadata.explanation: Restricts the copy to the 'vacation' subfolder (3 jpgs: hong-kong-china.jpg, hk_group_photo.jpg, monk252520thailand252520wat252520arun252520scaled25255B225255D.jpg). Evaluator awards 0.5 if all 3 vacation jpgs are present (exact count == 3 and all named files found) and 0.5 if emnlp2023.jpg from events/ is excluded — the exclude check only triggers when the include check passes, preventing trivial negative-control pass on empty cpjpg. [Fixed: renamed getter/metric suffix from 8-char '66c7bdf9' to correct 32-char MD5 '91c6f86e45abe96db716a4e3d1072be2' computed from '23393935-50c7-4a86-aeea-2b78fd089c5c|3'; added third vacation jpg to include_files; changed >= to == for exact count; made exclude check conditional on include passing]
fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed getter function from get_vacation_jpg_copy__66c7bdf9 to get_vacation_jpg_copy__91c6f86e45abe96db716a4e3d1072be2 (8-char suffix replaced with valid 32-char MD5 hash)
Fix 2: Renamed metric function from check_vacation_jpg_copy__66c7bdf9 to check_vacation_jpg_copy__91c6f86e45abe96db716a4e3d1072be2
Fix 3: Updated evaluator.func and evaluator.result.type in task JSON to use the corrected 32-char MD5 suffix
Fix 4: Added third vacation jpg 'monk252520thailand252520wat252520arun252520scaled25255B225255D.jpg' to expected.rules.include_files and metric default include_files
Fix 5: Changed jpg_count >= expected_count to jpg_count == expected_count in metric to enforce strict count and catch extra non-vacation jpgs
Fix 6: Made exclude score conditional on include_passed to prevent trivial negative-control pass on empty cpjpg (was awarding 0.5 for doing nothing)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads cpjpg/ listing via ls and counts jpg files with find -iname '*.jpg' | wc -l; data flow is semantically correct for the task.

Metric parameter handling is correct for expected.type='rule': directly accesses expected.get('expected_jpg_count'), expected.get('include_files'), expected.get('exclude_file') without any wrapping layer.
Trivial negative control is properly prevented: exclude check is inside the 'if include_passed:' block, so an empty cpjpg dir scores 0.0 (include_passed=False).
All 3 vacation jpgs (hong-kong-china.jpg, hk_group_photo.jpg, monk252520...jpg) are listed in include_files and verified with 'all(f in listing for f in include_files)'.
Strict count check (jpg_count == expected_count == 3) correctly rejects cases where extra jpgs from non-vacation folders are also copied.
URL-encoded filename 'monk252520thailand252520wat252520arun252520scaled25255B225255D.jpg' matches the literal on-disk filename set up by config download, so substring match in ls output is safe.
No postconfig needed since verification is purely filesystem-based (reading cpjpg/ directory contents).
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: 'f in listing' is substring matching over ls output; if ls ever outputs compactly (multi-column), it could still match correctly since filenames are unique substrings. Using 'grep -c' per file or splitting listing by newline would be more robust.
Minor: Consider also verifying that files are actual file copies (not symlinks) if that constraint matters, but the task instruction only specifies copying, which is satisfied by the current checks.
